purpose: Defines the overall system design of doc-link: system boundary, top-level operations and their connections, the overall sequence, and the common invariants that all detailed designs must keep.
summary: System boundary: doc-link handles document IDs, ToC, search, DLID resolution, reference checks and change-impact candidate notification
Write boundary: doc-link writes only DLIDs (frontmatter doc_link_id and heading-end section IDs), only via the explicit DLID assignment operation
Operation table: inputs, results handed downstream and write boundaries for DLID assignment, ToC build, search, DLID resolution, reference check, impact notification, inconsistency check
ToC build order: target fixing, ID check, change detection, info acquisition, reference check, candidate check, commit; unassigned or duplicate IDs are excluded and reported
Overall mermaid sequence of index-docs and the separate check-impact operation among project AI, scripts, content AI and project docs
Impact notification writes nothing; the project management AI rewrites the content hash recorded in the referring link title
Unreadable reference directories are recorded as absent without blocking commit
Common invariants: ID independence, directory scan for reference claims, no partial candidate publication, no stored notification state, bounded reverse references, per-key isolation
Storage method and cross-key visibility are deferred to the detailed designs DES-002, 003, 005, 006 and 007
